name_ja: 押し寿司（もろぶた寿司）
name_en: Morobuta zushi — pressed sushi made in a shallow wooden box, sandwiching sea bream between layers of rice
summary_ja: 浅い木箱「もろぶた」でシャリと具を挟んで押しかためた寿司。大村寿司と同じ由来を持つとされ、佐々町の近くで獲れる鯛を必ず具に入れ、大村寿司よりやや甘めの味付けにするという。
summary_en: Rice and fillings are layered and pressed in a shallow wooden box called a morobuta into a firm block of sushi — said to share its origin with Omura-zushi, always including sea bream caught near Sasa and finished slightly sweeter than its Omura cousin.
source_title: 押し寿司（もろぶた寿司） 長崎県
